name: Lens flare
description: Strong light reflects and scatters inside a lens, producing streaks or colored rings around the source or elsewhere in the frame.

name: Anamorphic flare
description: A bright source photographed through an anamorphic lens produces long horizontal streaks of light.

name: Starburst
description: Diffraction from an aperture or similar structure produces sharp star-shaped rays around a small bright light source.

name: Light leak
description: Light leaking into a camera produces reddish or orange washes and glows, often near the edges of the frame.

name: Bokeh
description: Out-of-focus point lights appear as soft circles or shapes determined by the lens aperture.

name: Bloom
description: Light from bright areas spreads softly into surrounding regions, emphasizing glow and brilliance.

name: Light streaks
description: Bright or moving light sources appear as elongated streaks across the image.

name: Light trails
description: A long exposure records the path of a moving light source as a continuous luminous line.

name: God rays
description: Light passing through gaps in clouds or foliage scatters off airborne particles and becomes visible as alternating bright and dark shafts.

name: Volumetric Lighting
description: Scattering in fog, smoke, or other participating media makes the path of light visible in three dimensions.

name: Atmospheric Scattering
description: Atmospheric molecules and particles redirect light, producing effects such as sky color and distant haze.

name: Prism light
description: A prism or similar material refracts different wavelengths at different angles, separating light into rainbow colors.

name: Caustics
description: Refraction or reflection through water or glass concentrates light into bright networks or curved patterns on nearby surfaces.

name: Dappled light
description: Light passing through gaps in foliage creates irregular patches of brightness and shadow on the ground or walls.

name: Glitter
description: Numerous tiny reflective flakes catch light individually, producing a dense field of fine shimmering highlights.

name: Sparkle
description: Intense reflections on gemstones, droplets, or similar surfaces create isolated brilliant glints.

name: Sparks
description: Hot particles from combustion or metal friction scatter as bright points and short luminous trails.

name: Light particles
description: Glowing particles or illuminated dust create the appearance of floating points of light in space.

name: Neon glow
description: Light from neon tubes or vivid luminous objects glows into nearby areas and colors surrounding surfaces.

name: Halo
description: A luminous ring or bright outline surrounds a light source or subject, creating an enveloping glow.

name: Laser beam
description: A highly directional laser appears as a narrow, sharp beam whose path can become visible in fog or smoke.

name: Light ribbon
description: Ribbon-shaped bands of light form curves or waves that suggest flow and three-dimensional movement.

name: Radial light burst
description: Numerous rays spread outward from an intense central source, emphasizing a flash or burst of energy.

name: Light sweep
description: A narrow band of light or a highlight appears to sweep across the frame or over an object's surface.

name: Ambient Light
description: Light arriving from the surroundings rather than a single direction provides general illumination, including shadowed areas.

name: Directional Light
description: Parallel light approximates a distant source and illuminates the scene from a consistent direction.

name: Point Light
description: A source emits light outward from a single point, with illumination decreasing as distance increases.

name: Spot Light
description: A point-like source emits light within a cone, allowing its direction and beam angle to control the illuminated area.

name: Area Light
description: A source with physical area produces shadows and reflections whose softness depends on its apparent size.

name: Spotlight
description: Concentrated illumination highlights a limited region, separating a subject or part of a stage from its surroundings.

name: Gobo lighting
description: A patterned mask placed in front of a light projects shaped areas of light and shadow onto walls or floors.

name: Emissive Lighting
description: A luminous object lights its surroundings when the lighting calculation includes its emission as a source of indirect illumination.

name: Rim Lighting
description: Light from behind or diagonally behind the subject outlines hair and shoulders, separating the subject from the background.

name: Backlighting
description: Light from behind the subject emphasizes silhouettes and translucency in hair or thin materials.

name: Soft Lighting
description: A source with a large apparent size produces soft-edged shadows and gentle transitions in shading.

name: Hard Lighting
description: A source with a small apparent size produces sharply defined shadows that emphasize shape and texture.

name: Low-key Lighting
description: Restrained fill light leaves substantial areas dark, using strong contrast to create a dramatic or weighty mood.

name: High-key Lighting
description: Generous fill light reduces contrast and creates an overall bright, light-toned image.

name: Rembrandt Lighting
description: Light from above and to one side leaves a small triangle of illumination on the shadow-side cheek, emphasizing facial form.

name: Split Lighting
description: Light from almost directly beside the face divides it into an illuminated half and a shadowed half for a dramatic effect.

name: Butterfly Lighting
description: Light from directly in front of and above the face creates a butterfly-shaped shadow beneath the nose.

name: Negative Fill
description: Black boards or fabric absorb surrounding bounce light, deepening shadows and increasing contrast or dimensionality.

name: Fresnel reflection
description: Reflection becomes stronger at grazing viewing angles, making the edges of materials such as glass or water appear brighter.

name: Subsurface Scattering
description: Light enters a translucent material, scatters internally, and exits elsewhere, creating the soft translucency of skin or wax.

name: Specular
description: The directional reflection component produces highlights and reflected images whose appearance depends on surface roughness.

name: Global Illumination
description: Lighting calculations account for indirect light reflected or transmitted between objects as well as light arriving directly from sources.

name: Indirect Lighting
description: Surfaces are illuminated by light reflected from walls, floors, or other objects rather than directly from a light source.

name: Radiosity
description: The exchange of diffusely reflected light between surfaces is calculated to reproduce indirect illumination and color bleeding.

name: Path Tracing
description: Light paths are sampled probabilistically, accumulating contributions from repeated reflection and refraction to form an image.

name: Ray Tracing
description: Rays are traced from viewpoints or other origins, using surface intersections to calculate effects such as shadows, reflection, and refraction.

name: Light Bounce
description: Light reflects off one surface and reaches another area, affecting the brightness and color of shadowed regions.

name: Ambient Occlusion
description: The degree to which nearby geometry blocks environmental illumination is approximated to emphasize contact shadows and crevices.

name: Screen Space Ambient Occlusion
description: Screen-space depth, normals, or related data are used to estimate occlusion and add shading around contacts and crevices.

name: HDR Lighting
description: Information spanning a wide range of luminance is used to represent lighting contrast and reflections from very bright to dark regions.

name: Tone Mapping
description: A wide luminance range, such as HDR data, is mapped to a displayable range to adjust tonal detail and appearance.
